CEC Recreations · BattleForce

12 combat enhancement cards, recreated from the recovered art panels (OneDrive archive, upscaled 3×) and the exact printed card text from Warrenborn's archived card pages. Frame, typography and point-badge placement are typeset in the spirit of the 2.0 card design — no complete card scans were ever archived anywhere. Rarity is not shown: it was not captured in the recovery.

49 pts
Scout Retrofit
Light
Attaches to Speed
This unit ignores any speed special equipment printed on its combat dial. This unit may use Evade and Reconnaissance at the same time.
SE RULE — Evade (AoD SEC sheet)
Evade (optional) This unit gets +2 to its defense value against ranged combat attacks. It fails to break away only on a result of 1. If this unit is a ’Mech, it does not gain 1 heat when it uses the run option.
SE RULE — Reconnaissance (Domination rules insert)
Reconnaissance (optional) This unit cannot be a member of a movement formation and cannot make a special attack. If this unit is given a move order, it does not use an order from your order total this turn.
BF-G-001BATTLEFORCE
66 pts
Infantry-Hunter Retrofit
Medium
Attaches to Ballistic
This unit may use both Anti-Personnel and Armor Piercing when making a ranged combat attack. When this unit uses both Anti-Personnel and Armor Piercing, all Infantry affected by the attack ignore their defense special equipment with 'armor' in the name.
SE RULE — Armor Piercing (AoD SEC sheet)
Armor Piercing (optional) This unit’s ranged combat attacks ignore other units’ defense special equipment with “armor” in the name.
SE RULE — Anti-Personnel (AoD SEC sheet)
Anti-Personnel (optional) This unit’s ranged combat attacks affect its targets and any infantry in base contact with those targets. First, make one attack roll and compare the attack result to the defense values of the targets of the attack. Score damage per the rules to each target against which the attack succeeds. Then compare the attack result to the defense values of any infantry in base contact with the targets. Score damage equal to this unit’s damage value to each infantry against which the attack succeeds.
BF-G-002BATTLEFORCE
65 pts
Melee Retrofit
Heavy
Attaches to Melee
This unit may use both Hand-to-Hand and Rapid Strike when making a close combat attack. When this unit uses both Hand-to-Hand and Rapid Strike, roll for Hand-to-Hand damage after each attack.
SE RULE — Hand-to-Hand Weapon (AoD SEC sheet)
Hand-to-Hand Weapon (optional) When this unit succeeds at a close combat attack targeting a single opposing figure, roll one six-sided die. Score damage to the target equal to the result instead of this unit’s damage value.
SE RULE — Rapid Strike (AoD SEC sheet)
Rapid Strike (optional) Once per turn, when this unit resolves a successful close combat attack against a single opposing target figure, make a second close combat attack against that target. This unit gains 1 heat in addition to any other heat generated by the order. The second attack does not cost an order.
BF-G-003BATTLEFORCE
98 pts
Guardian Retrofit
Assault
Attaches to Defense
This unit ignores any damage defense special equipment printed on its combat dial. This unit may use Advanced Anti-Missile System and Heavy Armor at the same time.
SE RULE — Heavy Armor (AoD SEC sheet)
Heavy Armor — Decrease by 1 any damage scored to this unit by ranged or close combat attacks. Heavy Armor does not reduce pushing or impact damage.
SE RULE — Advanced Anti-Missile System (Domination rules insert)
Advanced Anti-Missile System [X] This unit’s controller may cancel this special equipment prior to an opponent’s attack roll. (optional) When this unit or a friendly figure within 6” of this unit is the target of a successful ranged combat attack using the [ballistic] range type, roll one six-sided die. On a result of 3–5, reduce the damage scored against the target by 1, to a minimum of 1. On a result of 6, reduce the damage scored against the target by 2, to a minimum of 0. Apply the effects of this special equipment after applying the effects of all other special equipment and faction abilities.

50 pts
Stealth Retrofit
Light
Attaches to Speed
This unit ignores any speed special equipment printed on its combat dial. This unit may use Electronic Camoufge and Evade at the same time.
SE RULE — Electronic Camouflage (AoD SEC sheet)
Electronic Camouflage (optional) This unit ignores indirect fire ranged combat attacks and other units’ Streak Missiles special equipment.
SE RULE — Evade (AoD SEC sheet)
Evade (optional) This unit gets +2 to its defense value against ranged combat attacks. It fails to break away only on a result of 1. If this unit is a ’Mech, it does not gain 1 heat when it uses the run option.
BF-G-A05BATTLEFORCE
85 pts
Immobilization Retrofit
Medium
Attaches to Energy
This unit may use both Pulse and TSEMP when making a ranged combat attack. When this unit uses both Pulse and TSEMP, if the first attack succeeds and the target shuts down, this unit gets +4 to its attack value for the second attack because the target is shut down.
SE RULE — TSEMP (AoD SEC sheet)
TSEMP (Tight-Stream Electromagnetic Pulse) (optional) Give this unit a ranged combat order targeting a single opposing figure with zero or one order token. If the attack succeeds, and the target is not shutdown, give the target an order token after resolving the attack. If a ’Mech is given a second order token in this way, it shuts down; remove both tokens at the beginning of the controlling player’s next turn. If the target is at cruising level, it changes to NOE level; do not move it. If it cannot occupy the terrain at its NOE position, eliminate it.
SE RULE — Pulse (AoD SEC sheet)
Pulse (optional) Once per turn, when this unit resolves a successful ranged combat attack against a single opposing target figure, make a second ranged combat attack against that target, which gets +2 to its attack value against the second attack. If this unit is a ’Mech, it gains 1 heat after resolving the second attack in addition to any other heat generated by the order. The second attack does not cost an order.
BF-G-A06BATTLEFORCE
90 pts
TAG Retrofit
Assault
Attaches to Ballistic
This unit may use Homing Beacon and Streak Missiles at the same time.
SE RULE — Streak Missiles (AoD SEC sheet)
Streak Missiles (optional) When this unit makes a ranged combat attack targeting a single opposing figure, it ignores figure bases and terrain for line of fire purposes. If the attack succeeds, this unit gets –1 to its damage value for this attack, minimum 1. This attack may not target a shutdown ’Mech or a unit with Electronic Camouflage special equipment.
SE RULE — Homing Beacon (AoD SEC sheet)
Homing Beacon (optional) Give this unit a ranged combat order targeting a single opposing vehicle or ’Mech; it gets +2 to its attack value for this attack. If the attack succeeds, until the end of your turn any line of fire for a ranged combat attack using the [glyph] range type drawn to the target is clear, and the target ignores hindering terrain when it is the target of ranged combat attacks using the [glyph] range type.
Bracketed words stand in for the printed color range-type, speed-mode or attack-symbol glyphs on the SEC sheet.
BF-G-A07BATTLEFORCE
106 pts
Command Retrofit
Assault
Attaches to Attack
This unit may use Command and Improved Targeting at the same time.
SE RULE — Improved Targeting (AoD SEC sheet)
Improved Targeting (optional) When this unit makes a ranged or close combat attack, you may reroll one attack die; if you do, you must accept the reroll result. If you would roll a critical hit with the rerolled die, it is not a critical hit; calculate the attack result normally. If you reroll a die from a critical miss, and the new result is not a critical miss, this unit does not take critical miss damage.
SE RULE — Command (AoD SEC sheet)
Command (optional) At the beginning of your command stage, roll one six-sided die. On a result of 5 or 6, you get an extra order that turn.

13 pts
R.I.S.C. Emergency Coolant System
Heavy
Attaches to Attack
(optional) After this unit resolves an order, if it shows three rad symbols on its heat dial, it loses 2 heat and is not shutdown; do not make any heat effects rolls, and mark this unit so that it has one order token. CASE (Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment) II
Assault
Attaches to Ballistic
This unit fails an Avoid Ammunition Explosion roll only on a result of 1, and on a result of 1 is dealt unavoidable damage equal to its damage value -2, instead of -1. This unit fails an Avoid Ammunition Explosion: Critical roll only on a result of 1 or 2, and on a result of 1 or 2 is dealt unpreventable damage equal to its damage value -1 instead of +1.
